description: The release gate for a quick answer: call it with the reply exactly as you will send it, after the facts, decisions, references (cite) and exhibits/benchmark.csv are in the workspace. It saves the reply as answer.md and checks that every number in it is a registered fact as its format prints it (or a credited published figure, or in decisions.json audit_allow), that directions, years, rows and names match those facts, that dollar comparisons across years state nominal or real, the method record (questions, literature, disclosures, references opened, assumptions, sensitivity, data needs, benchmark), provenance, links (online: true requests them) and secrets; rerun: true replays every exhibit recipe and fact. Returns one line per check, the failures with their messages (verbose: every check), and "AUDIT PASSED" only when nothing fails. Send the answer only after it passes.

answer.description: The reply as it will be sent (Markdown)

rerun.description: Replay every exhibit recipe and recompute every fact

verbose.description: List every check, not only the failures

name: audit_answer
title: Audit a quick answer
